title: I Made ChatGPT Sell My Stuff And Negotiate For Me 🤯 #shorts  #ai #technology #aitutorial
description:
Want to sell things online without doing all the manual work? In this video, I reveal how to automate your sales process with just four simple ChatGPT prompts.

Simply upload photos of the items you want to sell. With the first prompt, ChatGPT identifies each item, estimates its current market value, and suggests a realistic selling price. The second prompt writes complete marketplace listings, including a highly-converting title and description.

But here is where it gets crazy: instead of copying and pasting, the third prompt tells ChatGPT to open its own browser and automatically create the Facebook Marketplace listings for you. Finally, the fourth prompt schedules a task for ChatGPT to check for new buyers every 24 hours and negotiate the best possible price on your behalf. This isn't just about generating text; it's about giving ChatGPT an entire automated workflow.
